records.assessment: Current law distinguishes three weeks for illiquidity and six for overindebtedness, with immediate filing absent culpable delay. The paragraph first restricts discussion to already-insolvent companies, so coexisting illiquidity or an immediate obligation remains an affirmative rescue. Linking the sentence to balance-sheet overindebtedness creates concern but does not prove the author intended a general legal-overindebtedness deadline.
records.limits: Do not treat six weeks as an unconditional grace period, negative equity as automatically legal insolvency, or absent company facts as proof of an error.
